message_text: [Call from 0201XXXXXX] Caller says: Good afternoon, I am calling from MoMo customer care. We detected a problem on your account and to protect your money you must read out the code we just sent to your phone.
grounding_note: RECON | Documented scenario: rep knows your name, claims account problem, urgency, asks to confirm a just-sent code (MyJoyOnline opinion 27 Jul 2026) https://www.myjoyonline.com/when-the-call-sounds-genuine-how-mobile-money-fraud-continues-to-target-ghanaians/ ; MTN says official calls come only from 0244300000 and no staff ask for PIN/OTP https://gna.org.gh/2025/12/mtn-announces-anti-fraud-initiatives-as-it-honours-200-momo-partners/

message_text: [SMS from MTN] Thank you for using MoMo. You are automatically entered into the MoMo promo draw. No customer is ever asked to pay to take part or to redeem a prize. Never share your PIN or OTP. T&Cs apply.
grounding_note: SYNTH-BENIGN | benign_subtype=genuine_telecom | Modelled on MTN's Nov 2025 statement that a real promotion exists but nobody pays to participate or redeem. https://newscenta.com/?p=24721 | Wording constructed, not an MTN original. Hard negative against fake-prize scams.

message_text: [WhatsApp from saved contact 'Kofi Work'] Hey sorry, I sent my WhatsApp verification code to your number by mistake. Please forward it to me quickly, it's urgent.
grounding_note: RECON | Fact-Check Ghana documents the 'sent my code by mistake' ploy https://www.fact-checkghana.com/whatsapp-account-takeover-how-it-works-and-how-to-prevent-it/ ; CSA CERT alert https://csa.gov.gh/cert-gh-alert9.php ; CSA says Q1 2024 takeovers equalled all of 2023 https://opemsuo.com/?p=130864

message_text: [SMS from 0508XXXXXX] CONGRATULATION!! You have WON GHS 10,000 in MTN MoMo Bonanza. To claim send GHS 100 processing fee to 0243XXXXXX then call 0508XXXXXX. Ref: MTN/9988
grounding_note: RECON | MTN says it never sends prize messages riddled with typos https://orange1079fm.com/?p=3752 ; genuine MTN promos never require payment https://newscenta.com/?p=24721 ; BoG lists fake promotions as a MoMo fraud type https://www.myjoyonline.com/avoiding-fraud

Cautious answer: verify by voice call first. Twi wording author-composed - validate with a native speaker.

message_text: [SMS from 0555XXXXXX] MTN MoMo: Your account has been flagged and will be BLOCKED within 24hrs. Update your KYC now at hxxp://momo-kyc-update[.]example/verify to avoid suspension.
grounding_note: RECON | MTN Ghana and BoG warned (2024) of fake SMS asking KYC updates or MoMo confirmation via links https://www.newsghana.com.gh/mtn-ghana-warns-customers-against-phishing-link-scams/ ; MTN never asks for passwords/PINs through a text link https://mtn.com.gh/?p=47994

message_text: [SMS from unknown number] Mum, this is Kojo. My phone fell in water so I'm using a friend's number. I've had an accident, please send GHS 1,500 to 0241XXXXXX for the hospital. Don't call.
grounding_note: RECON | 'Distress message' trick that targets the victim's contacts; JBKlutse advises insisting on hearing the person's voice https://jbklutse.com/?p=83514

message_text: [SMS from MobileMoney] Your MoMo wallet has been temporarily restricted for 48 hours following a SIM replacement on your number. Visit an MTN service centre with a valid ID to restore full access. If you did not request this, call 100.
grounding_note: SYNTH-BENIGN | benign_subtype=genuine_telecom | Modelled on the BoG rule (Payment Systems and Services Act 2019, s.34(3)) deactivating an e-money account for two days after a SIM swap until valid ID is shown https://www.myjoyonline.com/gh%C8%BC4-6-million-lost-to-sim-swap-fraud-in-2023-bog-reports/ ; MTN blocks PIN reset 48h after SIM reallocation https://commsrisk.com/?p=31074 | Exact operator wording not verified. Hard negative against account-blocking scams.

message_text: [WhatsApp] Congratulations! You have been selected as Data Collector, Ghana Statistical Service, GHS 3,500/month. Pay GHS 150 registration and uniform fee to 054XXXXXXX to confirm your slot. No interview needed.
grounding_note: RECON | Fact-Check Ghana documented a fake Ghana Statistical Service recruitment portal shared on WhatsApp with an instant 'approved' message https://www.fact-checkghana.com/?p=8230 ; upfront-fee job scams per CSA https://graphic.com.gh/news/general-news/victims-lose-over-ghc124-000-to-job-scams-csa.html

message_text: [Call showing 0244300000] Caller: Good morning, we are doing a routine check on your MoMo account. Please confirm your full name and date of birth.
grounding_note: SYNTH-AMBIG | closest_pattern=MoMo impersonation | 0244300000 is MTN's documented official number and MTN says no one calling from it asks for PIN or OTP https://amaghanaonline.com/2025/10/08/agbogbloshie-mtn-momo-shine-your-eye-campaign-empowers-customers-to-guard-against-fraud ; but caller-ID spoofing is possible (general knowledge, not source-confirmed) and identity-data harvesting precedes takeover. Cautious answer: share no PIN/OTP, verify via 100 or the official channel.

message_text: [USER REPORT] A man who said he was from MTN called about a problem on my MoMo. He told me a code was coming and I should read it out. I did, and now my wallet balance is zero. What should I do?
grounding_note: CASE-BASED | Pattern from https://www.myjoyonline.com/when-the-call-sounds-genuine-how-mobile-money-fraud-continues-to-target-ghanaians/ and a BoG-reported victim account of a fake MTN caller emptying a wallet https://mobile.ghanaweb.com/GhanaHomePage/business/Securing-Digital-Payments-The-need-for-advanced-security-measures-1969948 | Ideal reply is urgent action: call 100, police, CSA 292; recovery is not guaranteed https://www.businessghana.com/site/news/general/353963/Call-292-before-sending-money-to-suspected-fraudsters-Cyber-Security-Authority-warns | Composed first-person report.

grounding_note: RECON | ECG alert on fake meter sales and phone calls demanding MoMo payments; ECG says pay only via the Power App or *226# https://www.graphic.com.gh/news/general-news/scammers-target-ecg-customers-with-fake-meter-sales-and-momo-payment-calls.html
